scope: Primary-source research only; production addon remains 0.1.9; no game launch or external addon execution
conclusion: The examined addons use GUID for identity lookup and a supported unit reference or native nameplate for interaction. No verified raw-GUID combat cast implementation was found for this client.

plugins.name: HealBot
plugins.guid_role: existing button lookup; same-name threat display numbering
plugins.cast_target: unit attribute or @unit macro: target/focus/group targets/arena/boss

plugins.name: Cell
plugins.cast_target: mouseover or secure-resolved button unit; NPC bars boss1..boss8

plugins.name: oUF
plugins.cast_target: existing secure unit frames; native nameplate handles interaction with custom non-mouse visual

plugins.name: Plater
plugins.cast_target: native nameplate interaction; custom visual is mouse-disabled

plugins.name: EnemyGrid
plugins.compatibility: 90105 historical, not proof for current Forever

plugins.name: Clique
plugins.cast_target: copies existing button unit to proxy; no GUID cast conversion

plugins.name: Enemy Frames
plugins.guid_role: interaction retained on native plate identity
plugins.cast_target: native nameplate hit-test area aligned to list using enlarged native plate
plugins.current_status: author project page explicitly reports click targeting broken in newest update

native.guid_to_unit_api: UnitTokenFromGUID exists; returns string/nil and may be restricted
native.standard_button_guard: UnitExists(unit)==false returns before secure type spell executes
native.not_proven: Lack of UnitGUID in restricted environment alone does not prove all pre-stored raw-GUID cast paths impossible. C++ acceptance and raw-GUID macro parsing remain untested.

next_proof_required: GUID-to-token round trip on actual client
separate raw-GUID secure button and raw-GUID macro tests with positive target control and no current-target false positive
same-name destination GUID or independent per-GUID effect evidence; SENT name and SUCCEEDED alone insufficient
